        "history of present illness": r"history of present illness",

        "symptoms": r"symptoms(?: experienced by the patient)?",
        "new medications": r"new medications(?: prescribed or changed)?(?:,? including dosages)?(?: \(n/a if not provided\))?",
        "follow-up instructions": r"follow[- ]?up instructions(?: \(n/a if not provided\))?",
    }

        line = line.replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")

        m = re.match(r"^(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$", line)
        if not m:

            if mm and mm.group(1):

                break
